blocks.text: Several moon rhythms demand rest at different times.
Location: The Orchard of Borrowed Moons
Appearance: Three suspended crescents change phase on independent clocks and shed slow sleep-light ticks.
Care: Rest and recovery time help; avoid repeatedly exhausting the affected skill.
Story connection: A future moon festival could reveal who first borrowed the orchard’s light.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
